upstox_mcx_options.source: Upstox help: commodity options — ₹20/order, MCX txn 0.0418% of premium, CTT 0.05% sell, stamp 0.003% buy, SEBI ₹10/crore, GST 18% on brokerage+txn+SEBI

delta_india_options.source: https://www.delta.exchange/fees — options taker 0.03% / maker 0.010% of notional, cap 3.5% of premium, +18% GST

paper_fills.notes: Fill at mid ± fraction of bid-ask. Missing quotes reject the spread (all-or-none); exits never invent prices. Fees use venue schedules, not round-trip stubs.

delta_india.source: Delta India options typical order/position cap; override from ticker position_size when present

upstox_mcx.source: MCX freeze / broker max lots — conservative default; do not exceed exchange freeze qty

forward_test.notes: After a forward-test cycle closes, the same signal_key (underlying+expiry+structure+sorted strikes) cannot open again until 6 hours elapse. A QUALIFIED row that stays qualified is not a new trade while one is open.

live_orders.notes: Built locked. Production must not set TARANG_LIVE_ENABLED. Shadow logs payloads and sends nothing. Reconciliation only considers tarang- tagged orders.

upstox_ws.notes: Phase 1 uses REST Option Greek primarily. Shared upstox_market_feed batches of 100; Tarang may register via set_feed_provider_keys('tarang', keys) capped at max_keys for screener-needed strikes only. Do not change CommDiv behaviour.

ENERGY.rationale: Operator-set: default ₹5,000 / hard cap ₹10,000 / portfolio ₹10,000. ENERGY trades minis (CRUDEOILM / NATGASMINI). Do not raise these numbers if a candidate cannot fit.

CRYPTO.rationale: Delta BTC/ETH contract_value (0.001 / 0.01) keeps per-contract max loss well under ₹3k–10k at profile widths; keep strategy-doc default until live fills prove otherwise.
